items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I knew Tommy better, you know. I didn't do any work for him... I was busy in the studios. I was content.

ctx.x: No more than usual. They didn't room together. I was rooming with Jimmy, but Jimmy came around and said, 'The brother's going to quit.' That's the way they talked about each other. Tommy called Jimmy 'lad.' 'Hey, lad,' and he was younger.
